ItemId.description: The estimate's 26-character id. A draft with this id is replaced; a sent estimate with this id is kept as it is.

Number.description: The estimate's number, kept as it is. Required on a sent estimate.

Status.description: Draft, Sent, Accepted, Declined, Expired, Canceled or Invoiced.

ExpiryDate.description: The last day it can be accepted, yyyy-MM-dd.

Lines.description: The lines, as on an invoice.

Estimates.description: The estimates to import, as an Estimates deployment step writes them.
